508.dev Soundboard

Release builds of 508.dev Soundboard, signed with the same key as the APKs attached to its GitHub Releases — so you can move between the two without uninstalling. Built and published from CI on every tagged release.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://508-dev.github.io/soundboard/fdroid/repo
